name: Baid Finserv Limited
summary: Baid Finserv Limited is an Indian non-banking financial company offering loans for cars, commercial vehicles and small and medium-sized enterprises, plus secured loans against property and other assets. It also supplies life, home and motor insurance. It started in 1991 as Baid Leasing and Finance Co. Ltd., took its current name in July 2022 and is headquartered in Jaipur.
